## Overview

OpenAI is restoring a five-hour usage limit on Codex and ChatGPT Work for ChatGPT Plus subscribers, effective August 25, 2026, according to [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/24/openai-restores-5-hour-codex-and-work-limits-for-chatgpt-plus-users/). Following several weeks during which Plus users were subject only to a weekly usage cap, [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/24/openai-restores-5-hour-codex-and-work-limits-for-chatgpt-plus-users/) reports that OpenAI announced it is...

Full plain-text extraction and read of all three snapshots (source-0.html.gz = 9to5Mac, 'OpenAI restores 5-hour Codex and Work limits for ChatGPT Plus users', Marcus Mendes, Aug 24 2026 6:47pm PT; source-1.html.gz = Android Authority, 'Bad news: ChatGPT Plus users have annoying limits once again', Akshay Gangwar, Aug 25 2026 3:11am ET; source-2.html.gz = NewsBytes, 'OpenAI brings back 5-hour Codex limit for ChatGPT Plus', Mudit Dube, Aug 25 2026 12:02pm). Every claim in the article body was traced to its cited source and confirmed present: the Aug 25 effective date (verbatim 'starting tomorrow (25)' in 9to5Mac published Aug 24, 'starting August 25' in Android Authority, 'effective from August 25' in NewsBytes -- all three converge, no contradictory dates found anywhere); Sottiaux's title 'engineering lead for Codex and ChatGPT' (verbatim match in both 9to5Mac and NewsBytes, correctly not conflated with Android Authority's own paraphrase 'head of Codex and ChatGPT'); the direct quote 'the 5h limit allows us to smoothen the load on our compute, allowing to keep the plan generous in terms of weekly usage' (verbatim substring of Sottiaux's X post as reproduced by 9to5Mac); the reset/credit-purchase mechanic, the free/promotional bank-reset detail, the 'another million active users' milestone (verbatim in 9to5Mac and NewsBytes -- notably NOT the '8 million active users' figure the contributor bot said it caught and discarded as a hallucination in an earlier fetch pass), the GPT-5.6 removal context (Android Authority), and the Pro-tier exemption with Sottiaux's 'couple of months' forward-looking note (Android Authority, matches almost verbatim).
